headlines.title: Cuban Journalist Henry Constantin Enters Prison
Is a Peaceful Transition in Cuba Possible?
The Showman and Racism in Cuba
Cuba warns against ‘law of the jungle’ as Foreign Minister denounces US pressure
China pushes back against US on Iran and Cuba in UN speech

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Cuban journalist Henry Constantin has entered prison. [1]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR CUBA
Cuba's denunciation of US pressure comes as the country is linked to 120 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations. [4][E3]

KEY RISKS
Cuba is linked to 120 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, which could increase economic pressure. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Cuba, "US strike on Cuba by December 31?", is priced Yes at 15% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027. [E5]
A Polymarket market related to Cuba, "Miguel Díaz-Canel out as leader of Cuba by December 31?", is priced Yes at 16% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
The question of whether a peaceful transition in Cuba is possible remains unresolved. [2]
The outcome of the Polymarket market "US x Cuba economic deal by December 31, 2026?" is pending. [E7]
